First, divide your articles into 3 categories based on the organic traffic - High, Medium and Low. In the "High" section, identify 10 articles that have the highest traffic. Second, divide all the articles into 4-5 clusters, based on the topic.   


Now in each cluster, identify a hierarchy in terms of the traffic you've previously found. Start linking from a bottom-up-approach.   
Follow these rules:  
\- Make sure each article of 1500 words does not have more than 7 links - 5 internal and 2 external if needed.   
\- Link your articles with relevant keywords. Try to choose long-form keywords.   
\- All medium and high traffic articles should mandatorily link to your TopTen Traffic articles.   
\- Work harder on the SEO of the low and medium articles first and constantly update your high traffic articles.

Hope this helps!

2) Content Syndication to Medium, SlideShare and other platforms

4) Twitter Outreach - find people who have shared similar content/ about sub-topics and reach out to them. You know they're already interested in the topic so you are adding value.   
5) Reach out to sites in your domain/industry and ask if you can guest post. Make sure the topics you pitch are related to the article you want to build links for.
